flows: Navigate to http://localhost:7860/demo/?bug=1 then type a valid email address into the email input field, click the 'Join the waiting list' button, and verify that a welcome message confirms the user has been successfully added to the list.

remark: type: Typing user@example.com into the email field
click: Clicking Join the waiting list button
wait: Waiting after the waiting-list submission result

summary:
The waiting-list form does not complete successfully in the explicitly selected broken build, even when given a valid email address.
Fix the waiting-list submission flow so a valid email produces the welcome confirmation rather than the error message; then retest without and with the broken-build flag.
evidence: objective_contradiction: The submission shows “Something went wrong,” not the required welcome confirmation.
one_liner: Submitting a valid email shows an error instead of confirming that the user joined the waiting list.
